entry.name: City
entry.label: City name for weather / Grad za vremensku prognozu

entry.name: Quality
entry.label: Picture quality: auto (a still picture is sharp, animated rain and snow are half resolution) or low (always half resolution)

entry.name: AnimateOnBattery
entry.label: Animate rain, snow and storms on battery power too (off: on battery the picture is always still)

entry.name: Layout
entry.label: Multi-display layout: clone (whole scene on this display) or span (one scene over all displays)

entry.name: SceneDisplay
entry.label: Span: display (output name) that carries the terrace and the weather card; empty = the primary display

entry.name: HeightOffset
entry.label: Span: move this display's part of the picture up (positive) or down (negative), in pixels, to line it up with the displays beside it on the desk

entry.name: FrameRate
entry.label: Frames per second while rain, snow, hail or a storm moves (5-30). Otherwise, and on battery power, the picture stays still (redrawn once a minute for the sun and sky) to save GPU and battery

entry.name: CardCorner
entry.label: Weather card corner: tr (top right), tl, br or bl

entry.name: SideGlass
entry.label: Span: frosted glass on the displays beside the scene (off: the sky continues over them)

entry.name: PauseRule
entry.label: Pause when a fullscreen or maximized window covers: screen (this display only) or all (any display)

entry.name: Bundled
entry.label: Use the copy bundled with the plugin instead of the online page
